checks.claim: Observation versus prediction; preliminary/verified quality and flags
checks.judgment: Product-specific flags differ; final preserves them rather than assigning one universal flag schema.

checks.claim: Required datum and station-specific vertical reference
checks.judgment: A shared datum label does not by itself establish a volunteer-to-station transformation.

checks.claim: GMT, fixed LST and DST-adjusted LST/LDT
checks.judgment: UTC matching and unresolved folds are proposed policies, not measured data correctness.

checks.claim: Observed-product retrieval limits apply per request
checks.judgment: L1: a four-day per-request limit does not forbid a month assembled from authorized chunks.

checks.claim: Prediction intervals and range limits differ from observations
checks.judgment: Finer output spacing is not a documented accuracy or independent-observation improvement.

checks.claim: Harmonic versus subordinate high/low capability and internal reference
checks.judgment: Subordinate prediction heights require MLLW; no continuous tide curve is supplied. Noninterpolation is a conservative proposed policy.

checks.claim: Quarterly prediction updates and station history
checks.judgment: Snapshots are justified; no current station is selected or verified for the proposed month.

checks.claim: Metadata resources and classification fields
checks.judgment: L3: resources are named, but exact type/reference_id/refStationId field names and values are not carried into authored prose.

checks.claim: Harmonic calculation and weather/location limits
checks.judgment: Descriptive difference is appropriate; no calibration, weather attribution or navigation accuracy follows.

checks.claim: Distance and NOAA metadata cannot prove volunteer representativeness/history
checks.judgment: Inference from local datum/location-dependent behavior; absence of volunteer facts remains explicit.

checks.claim: v1.1.1 immutable release pin and shipped fix
checks.judgment: Tag resolves to f2ca0a2665b2d169c97de87b8e778dbed86aea07; no current-release claim is inferred.

checks.claim: Public merge_asof API and governing wrapper/caller
checks.judgment: Ordered keys, numeric/datetime keys, direction, exact control and finite tolerance mechanism verified historically.

checks.claim: Datetime conversion, sorted/null checks and dispatch
checks.judgment: Grouped uses _asof_by_function; ungrouped uses _asof_function. Both kernels independently read.

checks.claim: Nearest tie and duplicate row-order behavior
checks.judgment: Backward chooses last eligible duplicate, forward first; equal-distance nearest selects backward, with eligible exact-match and group conditions.

checks.claim: Matcher selects rows; it does not interpolate
checks.judgment: Interpolation remains a separate proposed option; finite tolerance alone is not proof against crossing every gap.

checks.claim: Historical bug described as incompatible-tolerance error-path behavior without governing no-grouping condition or valid-tolerance reachability
checks.judgment: D1: msg is constructed before validity checks. No-by double-index keys leave lk unbound even for valid Timedelta tolerance.

checks.claim: Fix is lk.dtype to lt.dtype and is released in 1.1.1
checks.judgment: One-line patch is real; its small size does not restrict triggering conditions to invalid tolerances.

checks.claim: Released added test is weak because early review says it passed without fix
checks.judgment: D2: early test contains by=ticker and seeds lk; corrected/released test omits by and reaches failing no-by branch. Static analysis, not an executed regression witness.

checks.claim: All application checks remain proposals; no executed application witness
checks.judgment: No empirical application, data, usability or performance result is presented. Source capture/hash checks establish identity only.

checks.claim: Privacy-safe local operation and exports
checks.judgment: Privacy details go beyond the frozen default but preserve it; no actual export or redaction test is executed.

checks.claim: Descriptive residual, per-location/epoch summaries and qualified coverage
checks.judgment: No numerical residual or invented coverage denominator; scientific comparability remains unresolved without volunteer evidence.

checks.claim: Exact/nearest/interpolation and unresolved tolerance/interval/tie choices
checks.judgment: L2: tie policy is prohibited from using an implicit library default, but is missing from the view-declaration field list and final explicit owner enumeration.

checks.claim: Already-covered and rejected dispositions
checks.judgment: Raw/interpretation/comments/gaps/context/no recalibration are inherited; byte hashes, aliases, duplicate suppression and concrete policy details are additions. L1 and D2 constrain rejection correctness.

checks.claim: Deployment support, speed and broader provider/plotting alternatives
checks.judgment: No version for deployment, superiority claim, performance claim, plotting selection or exhaustive opportunity recall is justified or asserted.

material_defects.identity: Mischaracterized and underspecified governing conditions for historical tolerance failure
material_defects.condition: pandas v1.1.0, left_index=True, right_index=True, no by/left_by/right_by, tolerance not None; valid Timedelta also triggers unbound lk before validation
material_defects.impact: Misstates pertinent issue applicability required by O3; masks a normal bounded timestamp-matching regression.

material_defects.identity: Obsolete review applied to corrected released regression test
material_defects.condition: Review at 59a07c22c68d5709b1718419007b60ab67f5ccfb versus corrected e7f668be34081d497bc8142ab0c77bb841e2964b and released f2ca0a2665b2d169c97de87b8e778dbed86aea07
material_defects.impact: Incorrectly discounts the released successful-match test; incomplete revision-aware issue/fix/regression analysis.

nonmaterial_limits.identity: Month-level one-minute observation rejection is overbroad if interpreted as forbidding chunking
nonmaterial_limits.condition: Four-day service limit is per request; line 45 already allows chunking. No claim that actual station availability was tested.

nonmaterial_limits.identity: Tie policy preserved generically but absent from declared view fields/open-choice enumeration
nonmaterial_limits.condition: Nearest matching yields equal-distance candidates; no executable implementation exists.

nonmaterial_limits.identity: Metadata resources retained but exact classification-field requirement only partially realized
nonmaterial_limits.condition: Station resource type=R/S and reference_id differ from offset-resource type/refStationId; generic English does not specify these exact returned fields.
